newsitem.title: JAPAN: Typhoon Rosie heads for southwest Japan.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon Rosie heads for southwest Japan.

text.p: Typhoon Rosie, packing maximum winds of 144 kph (90 mph), was expected to hit southwestern Japan later on Saturday, the MeteorologicaL Agency said.
At 10 a.m. (0100 GMT) on Saturday, the typhoon was about 140 km (87.5 miles) southeast of Japan's southwestern island of Shikoku, the agency said.
The storm, moving north at 35 kph (16 mph), was expected to dump up to 80 cm (31 inches) of rain, it said.
Rosie, described by the agency as a "medium-sized but powerul" typhoon, has already paralysed local air, rail and ocean traffic.
Airport authorities said nearly 200 domestic flights had been cancelled.
